question.text: CaO and NaCl have the same crystal structure and nearly the same ionic radii. If 'u' is the lattice energy of NaCl, the lattice energy of CaO is very nearly

solution.text:
Lattice energy ∝Product of charges on ionsInterionic distance

In CaO, the charges on cation and anion are twice the magnitude of charges on the cation and anion of NaCl. The interionic distance is the same.
